Title: Data Specialist
Description: This advanced individual contributor role goes beyond number-crunching – it combines technical data management with strategic influence. You will work on end-to-end sustainability data structure (tools and cadence) and define processes (governance, training, analysis, and reporting) with the goal of ensuring data-driven insights are at the heart of decision-making. A key part of your mission is to translate complex data into clear stories, for example: quantifying the environmental impact of our operations and projects, and crafting compelling, data-backed messages that demonstrate sustainability progress to both internal teams and customers. This role is intended for a high-performing analyst who will own the end-to-end management of sustainability data—defining the what, how, when, and where—while leveraging strong interpersonal skills to shape Dematic’s sustainability narrative through data-driven insights. What You Will do in This Role: Data Strategy & Governance: Define and govern the end‑to‑end sustainability data ecosystem, ensuring standardized, high‑quality ESG data and seamless, timely integration into centralized reporting. Product Owner – Sustainability Data Systems: Own Dematic’s sustainability data systems as product owner, ensuring reporting tools are well configured, widely adopted, continuously improved, and seamlessly embedded into global operations. Monthly Performance Reporting: Own monthly sustainability performance reporting by translating validated global ESG data into trend analysis, variance insights, and actionable recommendations for Operations and Sustainability leadership. Data Analysis & Insights: Analyze sustainability data to uncover trends, risks, and improvement opportunities, partnering with operations to translate insights into action and communicate results through clear, compelling dashboards and visualizations (e.g., Power BI). Key Deliverables: Monthly Sustainability Dashboard & Report: A concise, insight-rich report each month covering energy, GHG, and other performance indicators, with trend analysis and action recommendations. GHG/Energy Data Tool Implementation: Successful deployment of the new reporting tool across all regions – configured, populated with historical data, and actively used by contributors – along with user guides and training sessions. Impact Analysis: Clear analysis quantifying the outcomes of major sustainability initiatives or investments. Annual Data Package for Reporting: A complete, year-end consolidated dataset covering all required sustainability metrics, fully vetted and ready for internal and external reporting uses. Data-Backed Story Content: Contributions to sustainability communications such as charts, tables, and factoids for the Annual Sustainability Report, customer case studies, internal newsletters, and executive updates – all drawn from our robust data and showcasing Dematic’s progress. What We Are Looking For: Bachelor’s degree in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, or related field. (Master’s degree is a plus.) Approximately 4–7 years of experience in sustainability data analysis, environmental data management, or a similar analytic role. Strong proficiency in data analysis tools and systems: advanced Excel skills required; experience with BI/dashboard software (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and familiarity with databases or data management systems is highly desirable. Knowledge of sustainability and ESG frameworks and metrics, such as GHG Protocol (Scopes 1, 2, 3 accounting), energy management (ISO 50001 or similar), environmental reporting standards (GRI, CDP), and relevant regulations (e.g., EU CSRD). Strong interpersonal skills and influence. Comfortable working cross-functionally to obtain information and drive data improvements – you can diplomatically chase down data from busy colleagues and help them understand the “why” behind our data needs. Organized and proactive, with experience managing projects or processes. Preferred: Direct experience implementing or administering an environmental data management system or sustainability software tool as a power user or product owner. Track record of improving a data reporting process or leading a data-focused project (e.g., automation of data collection, significant upgrade of a KPI dashboard). Hands-on involvement in calculating and communicating the results of sustainability. Experience working with operations teams on environmental metrics (energy, fuel, waste). Any certifications or training in sustainability or energy management (e.g., ENV SP, Energy Manager, GHG Inventory specialization) or data analytics (e.g., BI certification) that demonstrate both domains of expertise.

We are responsible for delivering value by providing safe, efficient, and effective procurement and real estate services to Thomson Reuters businesses and functional operations. Our overarching mission is to ensure our colleagues spend less time and energy on ordering Services, ensuring their primary focus is building great content and products that delight TR customers and grow TR business. You will be responsible for the effective and timely delivery of digital solutions against their timeline and plan. You will lead digital initiatives spanning medium-high complexity. Thorough knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI). At least 2 years of experience in database management systems (SQL Management Studio). Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world. About Us Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news. We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments.
